headline: A young school needed administration and governance that match the trust parents place in it.
challenge: Schools answer to education regulators, employ staff and care for children. Compliance, safeguarding and clear agreements with parents had to be in place from the start, not added after a problem.
delivered: Employment contracts, HR management and parent and school agreements
Child safeguarding policies and data protection
Tax compliance, customer care systems and brand management
impact: A school with stronger administration and governance: compliant, clearly documented and set up to earn and keep parents' confidence.
